_doc: Shot types for autopilot. Codex classifies every clip into one of these (selected-takes.json keys). make_spec.py turns the flags into spec.json edit/audio lists. push_strong = action/hero shot that gets the stronger push-in; single = shown once as a still-ish shot; sfx = keep its original sound (pour, ice, cap pop, crunch); min_zoom = crop at least this much (busy backgrounds).

倒水.desc: pouring the drink into a (iced) glass - the standard opening shot

开盖.desc: twisting / popping the cap, tearing the pack open

产品正面.desc: front of the bottle/pack with the brand and product name readable

产品细节.desc: close-up of label details, texture, condensation, filling

配料表.desc: ingredient list / nutrition table / back label, text readable

制作过程.desc: stirring, scooping, mixing, heating, adding ice or straw

成品展示.desc: the finished cup/plate held up or on the table

品尝.desc: drinking or eating it (mouth/lips at the cup or food)

多件陈列.desc: several products, the box, the whole lineup

场景.desc: use scene: office desk, gym, sofa, fridge, outdoors
